exercise.title: Spider: every note ringing
exercise.why: A note rings when the finger presses close to its fret, the same press every string of a chord needs, so the spider is chord practice with one finger at a time.

cells.text:
Press Play below to start the metronome. Follow the tab, frets 5 to 8 with fingers 1, 2, 3 and 4, one note per beat.
Listen to each note. If one buzzes, press that finger closer to its fret when it comes round on the next string.
